title: Prove 1507-bank lower bound and exact single-row rank ceiling
body:
Every legal row order of the fixed fifteen-pivot native graph needs **at least 1,507 snapshot banks** under the retained immutable-snapshot contract. The existing order from [PR #7724](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7724) uses 2,106. The global minimum remains in **[1,507, 2,106]**, with a 599-bank gap. This is a lower-bound proof, not a new schedule. **No new kappa** follows.

The package also proves a precise method limit: **1,507 is the strongest bound obtainable from the maximal universally live set, its rank, the full endpoint information rank and a separate result bank at one fixed row**. All 7,643 anchors are covered. A stronger proof must use additional constraints, such as several boundaries or the actual complementary snapshots available. This is not a ceiling on the global minimum or on other proof methods.

Read the [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/54dd8940c86fe6b423e4b6c55e08764b1985eedf/research/banked-native-order-lower-bound/PROOF.md), [24-owner certificate](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/54dd8940c86fe6b423e4b6c55e08764b1985eedf/research/banked-native-order-lower-bound/CERTIFICATE.json), [receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/54dd8940c86fe6b423e4b6c55e08764b1985eedf/research/banked-native-order-lower-bound/RESULT.json), [verifier](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/54dd8940c86fe6b423e4b6c55e08764b1985eedf/research/banked-native-order-lower-bound/verify.py), [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/54dd8940c86fe6b423e4b6c55e08764b1985eedf/research/banked-native-order-lower-bound/SOURCE-PINS.json) and [credits](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/54dd8940c86fe6b423e4b6c55e08764b1985eedf/research/banked-native-order-lower-bound/CREDITS.md).

At row 88772, 24 snapshots must already exist and must remain for a read at or after that row, in every legal order. Their normalized forms have exact rank 19. Five explicit rational relations, including four equal-form pairs, prove the redundancy. The full endpoint has rank 1,501, so at least 1,482 other banks must retain the missing information. The new result bank must be separate before any donor read:

```text
24 + (1501 - 19) + 1 = 1507.
```

| Evidence | Coverage |
| --- | --- |
| Exact normalized coefficient pass | 8,533,666 products |
| Complete endpoint information | Rank 1,501 modulo a verified prime, hence over the rationals |
| Every row anchor | 7,063 distinct forced sets; 188,816 owner incidences; rational defect at most five |
| Attaining defect certificate | 24 owners, 19 independent forms, five rational relations, 970 relation products |
| Causal witness | Literal birth/use paths for all 24 owners; 95 listed path-edge checks |
| Prior upper bound | Replayed 2,106-bank allocation and all 169,343 donor reads |

The finite-field ranks give rational-rank lower bounds. Only the named witness needs exact rational equality to prove the ceiling is attained; the receipt does not claim every other modular rank equals rational rank. Corrupting a relation or dependency path causes the named check to fail.

Python 3.12, standard library only:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/banked-native-order-lower-bound
```

Both normal and optimized commands print:

```text
PASS_BANKED_NATIVE_ORDER_LOWER_BOUND 1507 <= optimum <= 2106
```

Registered normal/optimized replay, committed bytes/source history/modes, export verification and read-only sealed serial replay pass. The sealed export uses no Git and leaves all hashes and modes unchanged. Hosted CI did not certify this package. The [plan job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44386443702/job/135092193389) failed in the shared `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`: the base guide names frontier6030 while the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. The log reports 760 tests, one failure and 24 skipped; package replay was skipped. This package changes no shared CI file. Local replay remains the scientific evidence.

The contract retains all private entrance copies, distinct immutable token identities, exact donor lists, whole-row donor retention, result reservation before reads and common output installation. It excludes recomputation, in-place writes, merged equal forms, early output installation and public fields used as workspace. Only the snapshot component is bounded; source accumulator, scratch, guides, guards, child/adapter backing and parent storage keep their separate costs. Physical/caller replays, historical suites, selected cold replay, Lean and Docker were not run. All five framework interfaces remain inherited. No complete budget gain, global optimum or selected-frontier change is claimed.

Nick Petalas supplied the order and open question in the [PR7724 source proof](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ef52676eb20c252f5786f42a70ef0dd814400a03/research/banked-native-row-order/README.md). Ali Romman's [PR #7674](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7674) supplied the graph; [PR #7681](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7681) supplied the [storage contract](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1753a3ff56be34b09a217b12b590f51eba15defb/research/banked-native-snapshot-reuse/PROOF.md). SYLforge supplied the word and caller; Clear1nsight supplied the comparator encoding and digest in [PR #7682](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7682). All retained notices preserve predecessor credit.

The graph hash is `d81ec9f47740852a4bf7bd83100feff5cb66b70e1973466e1609bbac8af75098`. The consumed PR7724 head is `ef52676eb20c252f5786f42a70ef0dd814400a03`; the contract pin is `1753a3ff56be34b09a217b12b590f51eba15defb`. This PR starts from canonical main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. All 15 retained files are byte-pinned and unchanged. The graph reader and upper-bound allocator/replay are shared dependencies; no unmerged source ancestry is asserted.

Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in research, implementation, verification and writing. This is source-aware author checking, not independent human or formal-kernel acceptance. Apache-2.0. [Canonical claim and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19716353).
